$comment: Single source of truth for balance targets and run presets. docs/balance-targets.md §2 mirrors this file; on conflict this JSON wins. Consumed by balance-verify.mjs (verdicts), balance-cli.mjs (presets), balance-card-gate.mjs (cardGate). Changing a threshold requires a cited full-panel ledger run id in the commit message.

cardGate.spreadRegressionRule: candidate pooled-rollout spread must not exceed baseline beyond bootstrap-CI noise

provenance.factionWinPct: Hearthstone/vS viable-class band ~45-55%; HS devs treat sustained >55-57 as intervention territory
provenance.worstCellDevPp: HS real matchup extremes run ~70/30; 65/35 target leaves margin
provenance.mirrorFpEdgePp: 17Lands first-player anchor +2.7pp; this instrument read +1.6 to +3.0 pre-RD12 (targets §6-§9)
provenance.decidedPct: stall-class regression guard; >=85% of games must reach a decision
provenance.presetSizes: precision lives in the rollout rungs (the graded verdict layer: pooled r8+r12 ~2400/faction = CI ±2.0pp vs the 43/57 FAIL lines); GPP_MATRIX=1000 (CI ±3pp) suffices for the diagnostic random/heuristic floors, which are not graded evidence
provenance.pacing: watch-grade only — NOT part of ruleset-v1 acceptance (§13s-era addition per external vector audit: decided% counts turn-cap tiebreaks as decided, so natural-kill/tiebreak share is the missing guard against a degenerate tiebreak-heavy meta passing). Measured on the 3 rollout (agg) pilots of balance-runs/runs/2026-07-11_verify_34cf3a28_ruleset-v1-ratification-v2.json (2026-07-11), games-weighted across matchupDetail cells: naturalKillPct 99.97-100.0 (pooled ~100.0), tiebreakPct 0.0-0.03 (pooled ~0.0), turnsP50 32-33 (pooled weighted-median 33), leaderAt10WinPct 51.7-52.7 (pooled ~52.3, derived as 100 - comeback.pct games-weighted by comeback.n — the cell-level comeback field already IS the turn-10-leader-overturned rate), comebackPct 47.3-48.3 (pooled ~47.7). Bands = measured +/- generous margin per metric (naturalKillPct watchBelow measured-15 floored; tiebreakPct watchAbove measured+15; turnsP50 watchBelow/watchAbove measured+/-10; leaderAt10WinPct watchAbove measured+12; comebackPct watchBelow measured-12), all rounded to whole numbers. Print WATCH/OK, never FAIL; do not affect exit codes or the locked ratification verdict.
